mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='KN-01' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='KN-02' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='KN-03' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND event_type='source.upload.completion.requested' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.operation_id'))=#{operationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT d.tenant_id,d.event_id,d.consumer_id,d.status,d.attempt_no,d.next_attempt_at,d.lease_owner,d.lease_until, d.lease_generation,d.last_error,d.created_by,d.created_at,d.classification,d.revision,d.updated_at FROM outbox_delivery d JOIN outbox_event e ON e.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND e.event_id=d.event_id WHERE e.aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND e.event_type='source.upload.completion.requested' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(e.payload,'$.operation_id'))=#{operationId} AND d.event_id=#{eventId} AND d.consumer_id=#{consumerId} AND d.created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND aggregate_revision=#{sourceRevision} AND event_type='source.upload.part.stored' AND published_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT resource_ref FROM audit_event a WHERE audit_id=#{auditId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND action='document.upload.part.stored' AND result='SUCCESS' AND reason_code IS NULL AND request_id=#{requestId} AND trace_id=#{requestId} AND schema_version='1.0.0' AND schema_manifest_sha256=#{manifest} AND created_by=#{userId} AND classification=#{classification} FOR UPDATE

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND aggregate_revision=#{uploadRevision} AND event_type='document.upload.part.stored' AND published_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,upload_id,operation_id,source_id,version_intent,maintainer_id,request_json,request_sha256,schema_ref, schema_document_sha256,authority_grant,authority_revision,context_revision,auth_epoch,governance_epoch,schema_version, schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification FROM source_upload_request d WHERE upload_id=#{uploadId} AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT source_id,owner_project_id,ownership,classification FROM source s WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation c WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND conversation_id=#{sessionId} AND owner_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT session_id FROM source_session_binding b WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND source_id=#{sourceId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='source.upload.created' AND published_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
